connector.name: Convertfilefast
connector.registryDescription: Convert files, run PDF/image tools, create billing links, and report feedback.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.convertfilefast.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package convertfilefast-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mltcorp account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
